hook.text: Attention is the engine inside every modern AI model. It also has a memory problem.

intro.text: This is TinyAttention. A real FlashAttention engine, written in SystemVerilog. And it runs live, right here in your browser.

tiles.text: Instead of storing the whole score matrix, it works one small tile at a time. An online softmax keeps only a running max and a running sum.

engine.text: Two eight-bit systolic arrays do the math. Nothing on screen is faked. Every value you see comes straight from the hardware design.

memory.text: Both schedules compute attention on the same inputs. But flash moves nearly four times less memory on this run. And the gap keeps growing as the sequence gets longer.

trust.text: Every result is checked bit-exact against a golden model. Step through it clock by clock, and watch each tile resolve.

cta.text: Open the engine. Pick a preset, press run, and watch attention unfold, one tile at a time.
